title: RFC 9562 — Universally Unique IDentifiers
supported_scope: Defines 128-bit UUIDs intended for uniqueness across space and time and documents UUID formats and uses in distributed systems
limitations: Does not require UUIDs for self-storage define a unit identity operating model or prove collision-free implementation in any system

title: PROV-DM: The PROV Data Model
supported_scope: Defines general provenance concepts including entity generation invalidation derivation specialization and alternate relationships
limitations: General provenance model; not a self-storage standard inventory procedure accounting rule construction approval or implementation certification

title: RFC 3339 — Date and Time on the Internet: Timestamps
supported_scope: Defines an Internet timestamp profile including numeric local offsets and unambiguous date-time representations
limitations: Does not determine operational legal accounting or customer-effective time for a unit change

title: Data on the Web Best Practices
supported_scope: Recommends data provenance version indicators version history and persistent identifiers
limitations: Broad Web-data guidance; not a self-storage workflow standard system design certification or proof that this method was deployed
